main_body: Bonsai-style tree: three leaf-cloud canopies on a leaning brown trunk with a small grass tuft at the base
top_band: At x=23: light green rows 7-8 (L=110) with mid green above at rows 3-6, then darker green rows 10-11 and the outline. The trunk below is brown, rows 20-44.
evidence: This is an organic plant, so the 3/4 contract is read loosely. The canopy lobes are lit on top and fall to darker greens and a dark outline underneath, which gives a volume seen from above. The trunk reads as a vertical form below it. No receding side faces and no flat elevation panel. Reads as an acceptable organic 3/4 tree.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 11 distinct colours and a median of 5 colours per tile. The references have 427 and 567 distinct colours and a median of about 108 per tile. The canopy uses about 4 greens in blocky clumps with no per-leaf highlights or dithering. The trunk uses 4-5 browns with little grain. The outline is tinted dark green and dark brown, and flat-fill coverage is 0%, but the piece is far thinner and flatter than the Beodeul references and does not match their craft.
